paper_title: Searching for Scalar Dark Matter via Coupling to Fundamental Constants with Photonic, Atomic and Mechanical Oscillators
notes: Paper compares CSO, H-maser and quartz BAW oscillators to constrain scalar DM couplings via coefficient separation (not MRA). It constrains both d_e (ScalarPhoton) and the combination |d_me - d_g| (best limits d_e ~ 1.59e-1 and |d_me-d_g| ~ 6.97e-1) over 4.4e-19 to 6.8e-14 eV. Full mass-dependent exclusion is shown only in Fig. 3 with no numerical table; the emitted two-point line uses the paper's stated most-sensitive d_e value across the stated mass band, so it OVERSTATES sensitivity away from the best-sensitivity mass. The actual limit varies substantially with mass. Assumes local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and Maxwell-Boltzmann DM lineshape (deterministic amplitude phi_0). Projections for a future 5-year run with improved oscillators are also presented (green curve in Fig. 3) but the primary result is a measured limit. Confidence reduced because two coupling types are constrained and data points are only the text-quoted best values, not a digitized curve. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.5, 2))
